branches.theme: Master Glossary, Definitions, Formulas, and Laws

details: Definition: The degree of convergence or divergence of light rays achieved by a lens, defined as reciprocal of focal length in meters: P = 1/f(m).
Application / Example: SI unit is Dioptre (D). Convex lens has +P; Concave has -P.
evidence_or_examples: SI unit is Dioptre (D). Convex lens has +P; Concave has -P.

details: Variable Definitions / Units: u = object distance, v = image distance, f = focal length, m = magnification.
Model Application: Calculates image position and size for convex/concave lenses.
evidence_or_examples: Calculates image position and size for convex/concave lenses.
key_terms: u = object distance, v = image distance, f = focal length, m = magnification.
